title: Terms: row, item, list, tree, bar
description: One word per layout, with a definition and a tiny example, so bars, lists and tree rows stop overlapping.

add.text:
**Rule of thumb:** a *row* is a layout and a *bar* is a row with a look. An *item* is one thing, and a *list* or *tree* is items stacked.

- **row**: things side by side, centered vertically, one gap. It has no look of its own.
  `[icon] Name  3`
- **item**: one thing: an optional icon, a name, and an optional end (a count, ⋯ or →). It sits in a row, a list or a tree.
  `📁 Projects  ›`
- **list**: items stacked top to bottom, full width. Hover and selected get a ground.
  A sidebar nav.
- **tree**: a list whose items can open into a list, one indent per level, with a chevron to twirl.
  The layers panel. A tree row is just an **item** + indent + chevron, not a component of its own.
- **bar**: a row of controls with a set height and its own surface. One line, never wraps; extras go into a ⋯ menu.
  A toolbar `[B] [I] [U] | [search… 🎤]`, a tab bar, a status bar.
- **rail**: a bar standing up: a column of icon buttons on an app's edge.
- **pill**: the fully rounded shape (a search pill, a filter chip). It's a shape, not a layout.

**Looks:** a bar comes in a few named looks (plain, tonal, contrast) from [config words](https://monorepo.lew42.com/framework/ui/words/), so it never takes a one-off background.
add.title: Draft: seven words

add.text:
- [ui/row](https://monorepo.lew42.com/framework/ui/row/) means "one line in a list", which is really an **item**. Fold its padding and hover into item, and use "row" for the bare layout.
- [ui/item](https://monorepo.lew42.com/framework/ui/item/) already does icon + name + end, and nests as a tree. **Keep it.**
- [ui/tree](https://monorepo.lew42.com/framework/ui/tree/) / [ux/Tree](https://monorepo.lew42.com/framework/ux/Tree/) draw their own rows. They should draw **items**.
- [ui/toolbar](https://monorepo.lew42.com/framework/ui/toolbar/) is a stub. It becomes **bar**.
- [ui/icon](https://monorepo.lew42.com/framework/ui/icon/)'s "rail" is already the **rail** above.
- The Figma page "Cards · Bars" mixes bars, tree rows and item lists. Once the words are fixed, split it along them.
add.title: Where they overlap today

add.text:
1. Is a bar a row + a surface + a set height? **Yes.**
2. Is a tree row just an item? **Yes.**
3. Should the bare layout be called "row", or "inline" / "flex"? **row.**

**Next:** nothing gets renamed until we talk it through by voice (you also want to go over lists and workspaces). After that, the MVP is one page with each word, its definition and a live example. Then the code renames, in small merges, and the Figma page names follow.
